_comment: Known drift per frame/case: the harness fails when a case gets worse than this (plus slack: 2.0% pixels, 1.0 px bounds, 0.5 px font, 0.02 region). Regenerate with -PvitroParityUpdateBaseline=true; keep or write each "reason". An update records regressions too: read the diff before committing it, and keep the entries of cases with an open regression. #794 empties this file.

mirror/bar-card.reason: Vitro's bar-card isn't bar-card 3.2.0's look: HA draws a 20 px title row, square-ended 50 px bars with the name and value inside and a tinted unfilled part, and a white drop icon; Vitro draws rounded 40 px bars, the icon in the severity color, a smaller title, so the card is ~45 px shorter (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/bubble-card-button.reason: Bubble Card 3.4.3's slider button: HA fills the whole pill as the slider (65% grey-beige fill, name inside, no state line); Vitro draws a plain button with the name and '65%' on two lines and no fill (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/calendar-month-bars.reason: the tall month grid: HA puts the toolbar on one row (Today, arrows, title, view buttons) and draws timed events as a dot, time and title, all-day and multi-day ones as bars (School holiday spans 25-27); Vitro keeps the two-row toolbar, draws timed events as bars without their time, and splits the multi-day event per day with '+2 more' on the 26th (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/clock-date.reason: at 1.5x only (the tablet matches): the 112 px digits' and the date line's glyph edges (both cut the weekday at the card's edge, as HA does), 2.1% against the 2.0% slack (2026-11-25, fake HA, after #822)

mirror/clock-weather-card.reason: clock-weather-card 3.1.0 isn't drawn: Vitro renders it as HA's weather-forecast card (condition, 0.4 mm, five day columns), without the big clock, the date or the per-day temperature bars, so the card is ~107 px shorter (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/gauge-non-numeric.reason: Vitro draws HA's warning card as HA does (size, wash, icon, title, place); the only difference is the long 14 px bold title, which Robolectric's host Roboto Bold sets ~1.3% wider than HA's web Roboto, so its glyphs miss by a few px (the short 'Entity not found' of tile-missing-entity stays under 2%) (2026-11-26, fake HA)

mirror/gauge-unavailable.reason: Vitro draws HA's warning card as HA does (size, wash, icon, title, place); the only difference is the long 14 px bold title, which Robolectric's host Roboto Bold sets ~1.3% wider than HA's web Roboto, so its glyphs miss by a few px (the short 'Entity not found' of tile-missing-entity stays under 2%) (2026-11-26, fake HA)

mirror/history-graph-rows.reason: at 1.5x only (the tablet matches since #822's Roboto in the page): the fixture's step series has a change every few pixels, and their vertical edges land half a device pixel apart in HA's canvas and Vitro's, 2.1% against the 2.0% slack; axis, ticks, legend and colors match (2026-11-25, fake HA, after #822)

mirror/history-graph-two.reason: at 1.5x only (the tablet matches since #822's Roboto in the page): the fixture's step series has a change every few pixels, and their vertical edges land half a device pixel apart in HA's canvas and Vitro's, 2.1% against the 2.0% slack; axis, ticks, legend and colors match (2026-11-25, fake HA, after #822)

mirror/logbook-user.reason: changes made by people: HA shows each user's initial in a round avatar (A, S) from config/auth/list; Vitro shows the light's icon instead, so the three avatars are missing texts. Times, states and the timeline match (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/markdown-cardmod-has.reason: the sheet applies as in HA (:host centering, ha-card:has() tint, green heading, 18 px bold paragraph); left at 1.5x: Vitro's Markdown runs in whole device px, so the 18 px line sits ~1 px lower (2.0%) (2026-11-25, fake HA, after #822)

mirror/media-control.reason: at 1.5x: the 1 px border and the controls' icon edges (2.0%); the idle card's layout, colors and artwork placeholder match (the tablet matches) (2026-11-25, fake HA, after #822)

mirror/mini-graph-card.reason: mini-graph-card 0.13.0: HA draws a 2-hour-smoothed line filled to the bottom, the state at 32 px with its unit, no min/max labels; Vitro draws every point (noisy), a smaller state (21.4 at 26 px), min/max labels and a 48 px shorter graph (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/mini-media-player.reason: mini-media-player 1.16.12 with cover artwork: HA shows a volume slider with a knob and the progress bar along the bottom; Vitro shows a filled seek bar in the middle and no progress line, the cover art is placed ~70 px off (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/modern-circular-gauge.reason: modern-circular-gauge 0.15.0 fills its grid slot (a ~490 px square ring, 47 % at 90 px, the drop icon and the name below); Vitro's view lays it out at its own small size, cut by the card at the right (bounds off by 254 px) (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/mushroom-cover-closing.reason: text antialiasing of 'Office Blind' and 'Closing ⸱ 30%' at 1.5x; texts, shape and colors match (the tablet matches) (2026-11-26, fake HA)

mirror/mushroom-humidifier.reason: Mushroom's humidifier card: HA shows 'On · 41%' and a purple humidity bar without a knob, the icon badge purple; Vitro adds '· Target 45%' and draws a blue slider with a knob (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/mushroom-lock.reason: Mushroom 5.3's lock card, locked: HA shows one unlock button across the row; Vitro shows two (unlock and open). Name, state and icon match (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/mushroom-media.reason: Mushroom's media card goes to an island (native-options.json gap), so this native fallback isn't what a panel shows; the region check sees Vitro's idle card with two buttons where Mushroom shows one (2026-11-26, fake HA)

mirror/mushroom-media-playing.reason: Mushroom's media card while playing with use_media_info: HA shows the title, artist and volume, the controls in one row with a volume button; Vitro drops the info row and draws the controls as three big buttons over a volume slider (2026-11-25, fake HA)

mirror/mushroom-person.reason: Mushroom's person card with use_entity_picture: HA draws the person's picture in the icon circle with the home badge; Vitro draws the plain account icon (the picture isn't loaded) (2026-11-25, fake HA)
